notes.title: 06.02. Small patch
notes.content:
[b]bugfixes[/b]
-fixed boss puzzle not spawning reinforcements
-ranged attacker+abomination bug fixed
-progression labels showed incorrect information
-several descriptions fixed -carrot/goggles, orcgineer, scarecrow, giants belt, fire wand
[b]balance[/b]
-easy mode hag boss was too easy. Normal mode spawns big elemental every turn, easy one  now alternates between spawning small and big elementals every turn
-normal orcgineer boss now spawns 3 starting pods instead of 2. easy orcgineer boss now spawns 1 starting pod instead of zero
-fire archon boss is reworked

notes.title: Small patch 25.01.
notes.content:
[b]bugfixes[/b]
-AI no longer thinks it can attack twice
-AI now avoids auras properly
-poison helper visual bug no longer happens
-boss explosion visual bug no longer happens
-tutorial can now be finished properly
-ability descriptions now shouldnt be overflowing out of their boxes so much
-dialogs wont be shown twice in a row anymore
-a feared ally walking through the selected fighters tile will no longer freeze the game
-end turn cant be pressed after game is won anymore
-you cant reload the game to avoid taxes anymore
[b]other[/b]
-weapons are now rotated by 90 degrees instead of 100
-enemy spawning algorythm is changed, this usually results in less enemies and less potential for getting killed in one turn
-anybody combing from the entrance now has minus one speed for one turn
-hotkeys added - space=end turn, esc=menu,tab=bag 
[b]balance[/b]
-hp of horsemen reduced down to 14 from 16
-ritual mask now deals 4 damage to self on self click up from 1
-warlock boss reworked
-bootleg booze costs one more mana
-dark javelin has one more ammo
-heart weapon no longer heals enemies
-first time players have fighters with one more hp, until they get their first win
-famine weapon is now tier 5 instead of tier 4
-added more tips for first time players
-bee antennae now decreases armor as an aura, instead of a self-click
-bo staff no longer grants speed
